visualCharacteristics: Incorrect-usage tiles: rounded cover-fit image with a thin red diagonal strike line (bottom-left to top-right) drawn by the block, caption preceded by a small red prohibited icon
contentPattern: 9 'don't' tiles: logo misuse image + red strike + red prohibited icon + 'Don't ...' caption
usage: One row per incorrect-usage example. Cell 1: the misuse example image. Cell 2: the 'Don't ...' caption paragraph. The red strike line and prohibited icon are added automatically; do not include them in the content. 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile.
reuseGuidance: Logo / brand-asset misuse ('Don't ...') grids on the logos chapter and partner guidelines.
